hero.tagline: There are places where we live. And places where we truly begin to live.
hero.subtext: Casa Madre guides the purchase, sale, rental and investment of Barcelona properties — with a close, strategic and aesthetic eye.
hero.cta: Tell us what you're looking for

body: Casa Madre speaks of origins. Of that first place we all remember. Where we learned what it means to belong, to feel safe, and to recognise a space as our own.
But Casa Madre doesn't look only to the past. It looks towards what begins next.

A home is not just a place you arrive at, but a space where something new begins. And Casa Madre was born from this idea: the place where it all began, the investment that changes everything, the space where someone begins or closes a chapter of their life.

manifesto.title: We believe in a personalised approach to service
body: We are all different. We don’t feel, seek, sell or invest for the same reasons.
That’s why we don’t see our work as simply buying and selling property, but as guiding you through a new chapter in your life, offering a comprehensive, end-to-end service.
We believe a property is more than just an address or a number of square metres. It’s a place where memories are made, families grow and change, and life-changing decisions take shape.
At Casa Madre, we want you to feel at home, comfortable asking any questions and confident that we’ll help you find the answers.

founders.title: We are Evelyn and Eugenia
body: We met without introductions. We first heard each other’s voices, and over time, we met in person.
What began as a professional relationship grew into a connection: a shared way of understanding spaces, people and life.
Over time, our collaboration and shared sensibility blossomed into friendship.
And so, Casa Madre was born.

method.title: From the right choice to a method, from the method to success
method.intro: We don't believe in standard processes. We believe in understanding first.

steps.title: Understand who you are
steps.body: Before we talk about properties, we talk about you. About where you are in life, what you're looking for, and what you need right now.

steps.title: Valuation (The Key)
steps.body: An accurate valuation makes the difference between a property that finds its buyer and one that remains on the market.

steps.title: Select with judgement
steps.body: We don't aim for volume. We prefer to work with a select number of carefully chosen projects and give each one our full attention.

steps.title: Tend to every detail
steps.body: We care for the entire process — the paperwork, the negotiation, the timing — through to closing, without friction.

steps.title: When it repeats, it becomes a method
steps.body: What works, we repeat. That consistency is what turns our way of working into something you can trust.

network.title: Just as in every home, everyone has their place and something valuable to contribute
body: We are a network of people who share knowledge and combine our talents, all working with the same values: trust and commitment. Lawyers, financial advisors, interior designers, architects, collaborators and other professionals, each bringing their own expertise.
At Casa Madre, we believe this way of working brings people together, multiplies opportunities and creates greater consistency throughout every process.

ctaSection.title: Shall we begin imagining your home?
ctaSection.text: Tell us who you are and how you want to live. The rest, we build with you.

nosotras.headline: Two perspectives. One shared way of understanding home.
nosotras.body: We met in a house. One of us came from international advertising, the other from interior design. Casa Madre was born from that shared way of understanding how a space is lived.

detail.ctaHeadline: Tell us what you're looking for.
detail.ctaBody: We'll guide you at every step, with judgement and closeness.

items.title: Buying & Selling
items.description: We guide every transaction with strategy, valuation and judgement.
items.cta: I want to buy or sell
tagline: Every property is different. So is our strategy.
intro: Buying or selling a property is far more than a transaction. It is a significant decision, and it deserves knowledge, care and the right strategy.

At Casa Madre we guide each operation from beginning to end — from valuation and market positioning through to negotiation and signing. We combine experience, tailored marketing and a strong network of national and international contacts to find the best opportunities and secure the best results.
Our commitment is to make every transaction simpler, safer and more successful.

items.title: Rentals
items.description: Long-term and seasonal rentals, for owners and tenants.
tagline: The reassurance of leaving it all in good hands.
intro: We manage long-term and seasonal rentals with a personal service, for owners and tenants alike.
We handle valuation, marketing, candidate selection, negotiation and contract management, attending to every detail of the process.
Our aim is to maximise the return on each property, minimise risk, and offer an experience that is efficient, secure and free of complications.

items.title: Buying Agent
items.description: We search on your behalf, exclusively, representing your interests.
tagline: You picture it. We find it.
intro: Finding the right property takes time, knowledge of the market, and access to the right opportunities.

At Casa Madre we work exclusively for you, representing your interests and handling everything: from searching and shortlisting properties, including off-market opportunities, through to viewings, analysis, negotiation and purchase.
A tailored service that saves you time, spares you the worry, and turns a complex search into something straightforward and rewarding.

items.title: Renovation & Home Staging
items.description: We transform spaces to increase the value of each property.
tagline: We transform spaces. We multiply possibilities.
intro: Every property holds potential that deserves to be uncovered.
Through our network of architects, interior designers and builders, we design solutions tailored to each property, each budget and each objective.
From small home staging interventions to full renovations, we coordinate every project to improve functionality, heighten appeal and increase the value of the property.
Because a good transformation doesn't only change a space. It can change what it's worth.

items.title: Property Investment
items.description: We identify opportunities with strategic judgement and an eye on returns.
tagline: The best opportunities aren't always in plain sight.
intro: We identify and select property opportunities with strategic judgement, knowledge of the market, and a focus on returns and the creation of value.
We work with private investors, family wealth and family offices, offering access to selected assets and off-market transactions.
We analyse each investment, its possibilities and its risks, accompanying the client from identifying the opportunity through to closing the transaction.
Because investing well begins long before you buy.

items.title: Legal & Financial Advice
items.description: Legal, tax and financial guidance for every transaction.
tagline: The confidence of making good decisions.
intro: Behind every property transaction are legal, tax and financial decisions that call for rigour and expertise.
At Casa Madre we work with a network of specialist professionals, allowing us to offer integrated, coordinated advice tailored to each client's needs.
From contract review and tax analysis to finding financing solutions, we smooth every stage of the process.
Our aim is to anticipate risks, protect your interests, and ensure every decision is taken with confidence and peace of mind.

items.title: Relocation
items.description: We support your arrival and settling in Barcelona.
tagline: You move cities. We make you feel at home.
intro: Beginning a new chapter in another city should be exciting, not a worry.
At Casa Madre we offer a complete relocation service, supporting individuals, families and professionals as they arrive and settle in Barcelona.
From finding a home to choosing schools, guidance on paperwork, services and local recommendations, we take care of every detail through our network of professionals and partners.
Because arriving in a city is easy. Feeling at home is what makes the difference.

items.title: Casa Madre Concierge
items.description: Our network of professionals for the everyday life of your home.
tagline: Your home, your time, your life. We take care of it.
intro: Because enjoying a home goes far beyond simply living in it.
At Casa Madre we put our network of professionals and partners at your disposal, for the small and large needs of everyday life.
From arranging a private celebration, booking a chef at home or a beauty service, to managing cleaning, pet care, or designing tailored experiences and getaways.
You decide how to spend your time. We handle the details.
includes: At home — occasional cleaning, maintenance, gardening, floristry, wardrobe organisation, laundry, small repairs and tech support.
Celebrations — catering, private chefs, sommeliers, floral decoration, dinners, birthdays and private events.
Wellbeing and beauty — hairdressing, make-up, manicures, massage, personal trainers and yoga teachers at home.
Family and pets — babysitting, carers, dog walkers, dog grooming and home visits from vets.
Experiences — official guides, private routes through Barcelona, excursions, cultural visits, restaurant bookings, wine experiences and tailored getaways.
Personal assistance — shopping, gifts, errands, moving coordination, private drivers and household staff management.

hero.title: The Casa Madre Experience: A Complete Service
tagline: Much more than buying or selling.
Knowing what to do with everything else.

intro.title: The personal touch of genuine care, the rigour of professionalism
body: At Casa Madre, we guide you through every step of the process, making everything easier, simpler and more efficient. Whether you're buying, selling, renting, investing or transforming a space.
We seek the best solution for every situation, helping you avoid setbacks and achieve the best possible results.

closing.body: Every part of the process has its place. And all of it belongs to the same way of working: understand first, accompany always.
closing.networkLine: When a process calls for it, we draw on our network of trusted specialists.

aviso.intro: In compliance with Spanish Law 34/2002 on Information Society Services and Electronic Commerce (LSSI-CE), the following identifying details of the website owner are provided.
aviso.objectBody: This website provides information about Casa Madre's real estate and lifestyle services, and offers a means of contact for interested parties.
aviso.useBody: Accessing and using this website confers the status of user and implies acceptance of these terms. Users agree to make appropriate use of the content and not to use it for unlawful activities.
aviso.ipBody: All website content (texts, images, design, logos and code) belongs to Casa Madre or to third parties who have authorised its use, and is protected by intellectual and industrial property law. Reproduction without express authorisation is prohibited.
aviso.liabilityBody: Casa Madre is not liable for damages arising from improper use of the site or from information published by third parties. Property information is indicative and does not constitute a binding offer.
aviso.lawBody: These terms are governed by Spanish law. Any dispute shall be submitted to the courts and tribunals determined in accordance with the law.

privacidad.title: Privacy Policy
privacidad.intro: Casa Madre respects your privacy and processes your personal data in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
privacidad.dataBody: We collect the data you provide through the contact form: name, email, phone, area of interest, budget and the message you send us.
privacidad.purposeBody: We use your data solely to respond to your request, manage our relationship and provide information about our services. It is not used for automated decisions or profiling.
privacidad.legalBasisBody: The legal basis is your consent, given when you submit the form, and Casa Madre's legitimate interest in responding to your enquiry.
privacidad.retentionBody: We keep your data for as long as necessary to handle your request and, thereafter, for any legally required periods. It is then securely deleted.
privacidad.sharingBody: We do not share your data with third parties, except where legally required or with providers delivering necessary services (e.g. email delivery) under the corresponding data processing agreement.
privacidad.rightsBody: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction and portability by writing to our contact email. You may also lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (www.aepd.es).
privacidad.contactBody: For any question about your data, contact us using the details provided.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: This website uses only technical and necessary cookies required for it to function correctly.
cookies.whatBody: Cookies are small files stored on your device as you browse. They allow the site to work correctly and to remember certain preferences, such as language.
cookies.typesBody: We currently use only technical and preference cookies necessary for the site to function (for example, remembering your language). We do not use analytics, advertising or third-party tracking cookies.
cookies.consentBody: As only necessary technical cookies are used, no prior consent is required under current regulations. Should analytics or third-party cookies be added in future, your consent will be requested.
cookies.manageBody: You can configure or delete cookies through your browser settings at any time.
